notes: Both records identify Hu Gui of Tong'an as a Qing commander-in-chief and as the father of Hu Zhensheng. Chapter 335 records his death in AD 1760; chapter 350's later date hint was only an inferred generational bound.

Chapter 335 names Zhensheng as Hu Gui's son. Chapters 350 and 364 identify the same Hu Zhensheng as a Qing regional commander active in AD 1800 and killed in AD 1804; chapter 350 again names his father as Commander-in-Chief Hu Gui of Tong'an.
